column1: # docs/entity-ratchet.tsv -- the RATCHET FLOOR for plan_entity.md's three gates.
# Written by `tools/entity-ratchet --write`, checked by `tools/entity-ratchet`,
# run as the `entity` leg of `make test`. Read that tool's header first.
# One row per gated (and per reconciliation) row of `tools/entity-gates --tsv`.
# The leg FAILS when a number here goes UP, and passes when it goes down --
# plan_entity.md §5's "each phase may only lower it", applied to the gates.
# HOW TO CHANGE IT
#   you made a number smaller   tools/entity-ratchet --write     (no ceremony)
#   you made a number BIGGER    that is the regression this file exists to
#                               catch. `--write` refuses; `--write
#                               --allow-regression` does it and the diff shows
#                               exactly which row you widened and by how much.
# MERGING TWO LANES' VERSIONS OF THIS FILE: do not resolve it by hand and do
# not keep both. It is a MEASUREMENT, not a list of claims -- the shape the
# lane brief warns about, where two lanes each move one number and keep-both
# leaves a row that was never true of any tree. Take the merge, build, and run
# `tools/entity-ratchet --write`; the tool refuses to write a row that went up,
# so a resolution that hid a regression cannot be committed by accident.
# These are the numbers the port drives to ZERO. Every one of them reaching 0
# is the definition of done, and on that day `tools/entity-gates` exits 0 and
# this file is a list of zeroes.
# columns:
# gate
